title: 물량 배분 자동 비교 snapshot 불변 저장

criteria.interface: exports saveAudit({year,week,userId,report}), listAudits({year,week}), and getAudit({year,week,id}); optional root is dependency injection for isolated tests only
criteria.scope: year is an exact 20xx string and week is an exact WW-SS string with major week 01 through 53 and subweek 01 through 99
criteria.storage: private data/distribution-board/baselines/automated-audits only; one UUID JSON file per snapshot; temporary private write plus exclusive hard-link creation; existing files are never overwritten
criteria.authority: userId must be supplied by the future authenticated server API; client id and createdAt are ignored because the store generates UUID and server createdAt
criteria.report: requests, findings, unresolved, and warnings are required arrays; advisoryOnly must be true; report is JSON-only, rejects secret-shaped keys and values, and is at most 2MiB UTF-8
criteria.reads: list returns metadata and counts for at most the 20 most recent matching snapshots; get returns the complete immutable report
criteria.safety: strict UUID/scope/schema checks, lexical path containment, symlink rejection, and explicit corruption errors prevent traversal or silent malformed-record acceptance
criteria.separation: automated findings are stored separately and never overwrite, derive, or imply a human checklist disposition
criteria.erp: authenticated archive GET only; no SQL, DB module, ERP read, ERP write, completion claim, or workflow gate

crossYearFixture.description: A 2025 snapshot for the same full week is never returned by a 2026 list or get request.

dnspyEvidence.note: This append-only automated comparison archive is file-only, advisory-only, and preserves every EXE-facing table.
